label: POST_PHASE12_SLO_DEFINITION_SENSITIVITY_EXTENSION

primary_slo_rule.formula: slo_deadline = arrival_time + slo_multiplier * (PREFILL_TOKEN_COST_S * prompt_tokens + DECODE_TOKEN_COST_S * predicted_output_tokens)
primary_slo_rule.weight_interaction: ANWG/weighted_goodput weight = request.priority; Stage-0 synthesis sets priority=1.0 uniformly, so weighting is a no-op for every Phase-12 cell regardless of SLO rule
primary_slo_rule.priority_interaction: none: priority is not an input to the SLO-deadline formula

variant_panel.selection_rule: symmetric halve/double bracket around the primary multiplier, chosen from the sealed formula's structure alone, before any scheduler-ranking outcome under any variant was computed
variant_panel.transform: src/robustbench/analysis/slo_variant.py::apply_slo_variant -- rescales only slo_deadline via the exact identity variant_deadline = arrival_time + (primary_deadline - arrival_time) * (variant_multiplier / primary_multiplier); all other Request fields byte-identical by construction

scope.region_exclusion_rationale: LOW excluded: sealed primary campaign (paper/generated/table_data/rq3_reversals.json, primary_metric_by_region_class_counts) shows 0/36 supported practical reversals in LOW; the other 5 regions each contribute reversals (PRE_KNEE=6, KNEE=6, POST_KNEE=6, OVERLOAD=10, HIGH_PRESSURE=8) so all 5 are retained -- excluding PRE_KNEE/POST_KNEE would have discarded 12/36 (33%) of the reversal evidence base this extension exists to stress-test
scope.repetitions: none: the simulator is deterministic given identical Requests (docs/RANKING_PORTABILITY_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md SEED_SENSITIVITY_APPLICABLE=false); the sealed campaign's synthesis_seed per window is reused unchanged, only the SLO variant differs

expected_cells_formula: 3 slo_rules x 3 sources x 5 regions x 11 policies x 40 windows

slo_aware_policy_audit.edf: PRIMARY sort key is slo_deadline ascending -- fully SLO-deadline-driven
slo_aware_policy_audit.least_laxity_first: sorts by laxity = slo_deadline - now - service_estimate, tie-break slo_deadline -- fully SLO-deadline-driven
slo_aware_policy_audit.admission_control: admission/eviction laxity = slo_deadline - now - service_estimate; ordering also uses slo_deadline ascending -- fully SLO-deadline-driven
slo_aware_policy_audit.estimated_service_time_first: primary sort key is estimated service time (SJF); slo_deadline used only as a tie-breaker
slo_aware_policy_audit.scorpio_style_slo_guard: (STYLE_APPROXIMATION, not in PRIMARY panel) laxity-based like admission_control -- SLO-deadline-driven
slo_aware_policy_audit.slai_faithful: does NOT read request.slo_deadline at all -- its own deadline concept (last_schedulable_time) is derived from a class_id-keyed time_between_tokens table (DEFAULT_TBT_BY_CLASS), independent of the synthesized SLO field; since Stage-0 synthesis sets class_id='stage0_uniform' uniformly, slai_faithful's own scheduling decisions are structurally UNCHANGED by this extension's variants -- but its realized slo_violation_rate/ANWG still moves, because SLO-violation is judged post hoc against request.slo_deadline for every policy uniformly, regardless of whether that policy's scheduling logic consulted it
slo_aware_policy_audit.fifo: no SLO/deadline use of any kind
slo_aware_policy_audit.vllm_faithful: no SLO/deadline use of any kind
slo_aware_policy_audit.vllm_chunked_prefill_faithful: no SLO/deadline use of any kind
slo_aware_policy_audit.sarathi_faithful: no SLO/deadline use of any kind
slo_aware_policy_audit.weighted_fair_share: no SLO/deadline use of any kind (uses priority as fairness weight only)
slo_aware_policy_audit.kv_constrained_online: no SLO/deadline use of any kind

transfer_statistics.primary_ranking_robustness: for each (source, region), compare_conditions(primary_rows, variant_rows, metric=arrival_normalized_weighted_goodput) using the sealed src/robustbench/ranking_portability/analysis/ranking_analysis.py::compare_conditions machinery unmodified -- Kendall tau-b, Spearman rho, top-1 agreement, top-3 overlap, block-bootstrap CIs over the 40 frozen windows as the resample unit
transfer_statistics.reversal_persistence: for every SUPPORTED_PRACTICAL_REVERSAL recorded in the sealed primary campaign's canonical reversal output (frozen reference copy: configs/analysis/phase12_primary_reversals_reference.json), re-run src/robustbench/ranking_portability/analysis/reversal_analysis.py::classify_pairwise_reversal unmodified on the SAME source-pair/region/policy-pair using each variant's recomputed per-window ANWG values; classify as PERSISTS / DISAPPEARS / DIRECTION_CHANGE / BECOMES_UNSUPPORTED
transfer_statistics.secondary: policy-pair sign agreement (sign of ANWG(policy_a)-ANWG(policy_b) under primary vs variant, same source/region) is reported as a by-product of the reversal-persistence check, not computed independently
transfer_statistics.bootstrap_resamples_source: src/robustbench/ranking_portability/analysis/contract.py::BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES (reused unchanged -- not reselected for this extension)
transfer_statistics.practical_margin_fraction_source: src/robustbench/ranking_portability/analysis/contract.py::REVERSAL_PRACTICAL_MARGIN_FRACTION (reused unchanged -- dimensionally valid here because every comparison in this extension is ANWG-vs-ANWG under different SLO rules, the same dimensionless [0,1] metric the threshold was frozen for; no cross-metric unit mismatch arises, unlike a cross-metric extension would)
transfer_statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05 (src/robustbench/ranking_portability/analysis/contract.py::FDR_Q), applied per (variant, region) family, matching the sealed campaign's own family definition
